selection: Reject any take whose transcript differs from the line (after number and alias normalisation), or, for lines of six words or more, whose pace is outside 1.5–3.6 words/s; of the rest keep the one with the most pitch movement (std of F0 in semitones).

german.note: The German voice: speaks German words and sentences in the German lessons; the explanation stays with the English narrator. Chosen by the site owner by ear on 2026-10-10 (sample qwen_design_en_s1). Changing anything here regenerates every clip with German in it.

reference.made_with: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign (Apache-2.0): a voice designed from a text description, not a real person
reference.instruct: A warm, friendly female speaker in her early thirties, slightly low pitch, calm and natural, clear standard German (Hochdeutsch), relaxed pace with natural pauses
reference.text: Ich rufe dich morgen um acht an. Kannst du mir bitte sagen, wo der Bahnhof ist? Obwohl es regnet, gehen wir heute Abend ins Kino.

german.selection: Same as the English voice: transcript must match word for word (German ASR), pace 1.5–3.6 words/s on lines of six words or more, then the most pitch movement. Each German line is level-matched to the English lines in its clip.
